definitions.range: High-low range is diagnostic, not a substitute for a magnitude hit.
definitions.validation: Monthly walk-forward from 2024; 7-day purge; disjoint fit/calibration/selection; selection uses Brier loss, with a base-rate candidate.
definitions.alert: Probability >= max(35%, twice training base rate), capped at 70%; not a trade recommendation.
definitions.provenance: Index/Astro history without available_at assumes prepublication; retrospective research is not a live track record.

scoring.up: correct >= +3%; partial +0.1% to < +3%; otherwise wrong, including gains below +0.1%
scoring.down: correct <= -3%; partial > -3% to -0.1%; otherwise wrong, including declines smaller than 0.1%
scoring.sideway: correct within -1% to +1%; otherwise wrong; no partial

meta.availability_assumption: Explicit available_at timestamps are enforced before the target UTC session. Sources without timestamps are marked prepublished-imputed; market and intraday features lag two sessions so the daily artifact is fully available before its target opens.

warnings: private-index-btc has no complete available_at history; historical results assume prepublication
private-index-me has no complete available_at history; historical results assume prepublication
astro-scores has no complete available_at history; historical results assume prepublication

validation.calibration_partition: first 67% calibrator fit; final 33% policy and ensemble selection
validation.calibration_methods: identity, sigmoid, temperature, isotonic when sample-gated
validation.stacking: non-negative simplex weights learned only from pre-test OOS policy validation probabilities
validation.official_forecast_contract: issued before target UTC open with a two-session lead
validation.trade_gate: directional execution requires positive OOS net-expectancy lower bound after costs
validation.oos_refit_cadence: weekly full research; daily grade/rerank/publish reuses the latest verified OOS artifact
validation.drift_action: recent Page-Hinkley deterioration suspends execution but preserves forecasts
validation.quota_allocation: chronological, prefix-invariant; no later-date probability sorting
validation.class_probability: UP/DOWN class probabilities refer to returns beyond +/-1%, not the +/-3% exact-grade threshold
